macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory terminal tips occupy approximately 12% of the total vertical horn length from base to apex.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest of hair extending from the neck to the mid-back; high-contrast white facial spot visible on the lower cheek.
